task: Leg 14 step 1: the discretisation floor of launch_neff on a symmetric sharp slab, from the solver's own mesh ladder. The closed-form law is NOT evaluated in this run.

slab.index_source: configs/leg1-objective.json core_index and cladding_index (the N8 fixture)
slab.safety_factor_basis: The floor is twice the Richardson estimate of the fixture's own discretisation error, so that an estimate that is off by up to a factor two (an observed order that is not yet asymptotic) still bounds the error. Declared before the run.

stop_conditions: observed order outside [1, 3] on the finer pairs: the ladder is not asymptotic, no floor is declared
